data.body: AC amendment (from plan-review cycle 2): Extend Surface A to include CI workflow YAML files. Run `grep -r 'DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE' .github/` during this task and document any hits in the audit notes / PR description. Even if no code change is needed (e.g., the env var is set for the WARNING path only), this ensures CI YAML changes are not silently broken by the ledger-authoritative switch. Verify: `grep -r 'DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE' .github/` output is captured in the commit message or audit comment, even when empty.
